item.title: Service Ad Without Source Assets

turns.text: Make an 8-second 16:9 ad for ClearDay, a made-up app that turns a messy to-do list into a simple daily plan. I don't have screenshots or a logo—create a simple demo screen yourself. Show the messy list becoming an organized day, then end on ClearDay. Calm blue-and-white look, no sound. Any other wording is up to you.

item.tests: Creates a coherent app ad without supplied assets, visibly demonstrating the service instead of requiring screenshots.

answer_sheet.Service and purpose: ClearDay, a fictional app that organizes a messy to-do list into a daily plan.
answer_sheet.Screenshots and logo: None supplied; create a simple demo screen and choose the branding treatment yourself.
answer_sheet.Wording and language: End on ClearDay; other wording is your call, in English.

must_haves: The final video is 8 seconds long and landscape 16:9.
A created app demo visibly changes from a messy task list into an organized daily plan.
The visual design is predominantly blue and white with a calm presentation.

turns.text: Could you make an ad for ClearDay, which is a made-up app that turns a messy to-do list into a simple daily plan? I like the idea because my own to-do lists always seem to get more overwhelming instead of more useful. I don't have screenshots or a logo, so create a simple demo screen yourself, and the ad should be 8 seconds long in 16:9. Show the messy list becoming an organized day, then end on ClearDay. Give it a calm blue-and-white look with no sound, and any other wording is up to you.
turns.agent:
I couldn’t generate the ad because Magic Hour reported insufficient credits. No video was created.

The ad is planned as an **8-second, silent, 16:9 video** in blue and white:

- **0–2s:** Overlapping task cards under “Too much to do?”
- **2–5.5s:** The cards glide into a custom daily-planner demo: Focus, Break, Errands. Heading: “One clear day.”
- **5.5–8s:** A clean **ClearDay** end card with “Less overwhelm. More clarity.”

Once credits are available, I can retry this version.

approvals.name: create_video_from_text

style.prompt: Create an exactly 8-second silent 16:9 motion-graphics advertisement for ClearDay, a fictional app that transforms overwhelming to-do lists into simple daily plans. Design the original demo UI yourself; there are no supplied logos or screenshots. Flat, polished 2D software interface animation, crisp blue typography on white, pale sky-blue cards, gentle navy accents, abundant whitespace, calm reassuring mood. Fixed front-on view, no people, no device frames, no camera moves. Keep all text large and minimal for readability at 480p. Timeline: 0–2 seconds: on white, a loose clutter of overlapping blue-and-white task cards, with short readable labels such as 'Email', 'Groceries', 'Workout', 'Project', suggesting an overwhelming to-do list. Large heading: 'Too much to do?' 2–5.5 seconds: in one continuous smooth satisfying animation, the same scattered cards gently glide and align into a single clean daily-planner demo screen. Heading changes to 'One clear day.' The simplified app panel has a small ClearDay wordmark at its top and three neatly spaced rows: '9:00  Focus', '12:00  Break', '3:00  Errands', each with a simple empty checkbox. Show order and generous breathing room replacing clutter, with no extra UI details. 5.5–8 seconds: gently dissolve the planner to a clean white end card with centered large blue text 'ClearDay' and smaller tagline beneath: 'Less overwhelm. More clarity.' Hold the end card steady for the final two seconds. Minimal vector design, smooth slow easing, restrained transitions. No sound, no voiceover, no music. No unrelated brands, no claims about actual availability, no app-store badges, no watermark-like decorative text.
